scope.zh: 前超光速星球上最后一批居民被绑架时对星球所有者与观察站的通知。
scope.en: The notice to the planet owner and the observation-post owner when the last pre-FTL inhabitants are abducted.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现当地原住民的物种名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the local species appears here.
